items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer states 'I got to know him well' referring to Bill Evans, not Ernie Fields. Ernie Fields only asks 'He was?' indicating he is learning about Bob Nora for the first time.

ctx.x: He ran a band called Bob Nora, and he was the bandleader, more or less. He had a new Desoto limousine and I got to know him well.
I was a little surprised to learn that Bill Evans was Yusef Lateef.
